dataList.content: Mirror of the Wuthering
Season 4's Hầm Ngục Gương is called 'Mirror of the Wuthering'.
Choose between 'Simulation' and 'Ritornello' difficulties to enter.
Weekly Bonuses
Every week, Hầm Ngục Gươngs offer Weekly Bonuses. Use Weekly Bonuses when you're claiming the rewards for the run—and receive greatly increased rewards.
Every week, you can receive 3 Weekly Bonuses regardless of difficulty.
In Ritornello difficulty, you can use 2 or more Weekly Bonuses at once, and will receive rewards proportional to the number of Weekly Bonuses used.
However, it is more enkephalin-efficient to use all 3 Weekly Bonuses at once rather than to use them one at a time.
Sinners
You can view your currently deployed Sinners here.
Starter Buffs
Collect Ánh Sao from completing Hầm Ngục Gươngs and use them to obtain several Starter Buffs that will help you in the Hầm Ngục Gương.
Theme Pack Compendium
You can view the list of Floor Gói Chủ Đề that appear in the Hầm Ngục Gương. Selected Floor Theme Pack records will be collected here.
Quà Tặng E.G.O Compendium
You can view the list of Quà Tặng E.G.O that appear in the Hầm Ngục Gương. Obtaining an Quà Tặng E.G.O in the Hầm Ngục Gương will add an entry to your Quà Tặng E.G.O Compendium.
Starter Buffs
You can increase your chances of obtaining helpful Quà Tặng E.G.O during your Hầm Ngục Gương run by activating more Starter Buffs.
Starter Buffs do not change with the Hầm Ngục Gương difficulties.
Ánh Sao
You can obtain Ánh Sao from completing Hầm Ngục Gương runs.
The higher you rise through the Hầm Ngục Gương floors, the more Ánh Sao you will obtain.
Starting Quà Tặng E.G.O Choice

When you enter a Hầm Ngục Gương, you’ll be offered a selection of Keyword-based categories of Quà Tặng E.G.O. At first, you will only have access to the Random category. However, you can unlock more Keyword categories as you activate more Starter Buffs.
Quà Tặng E.G.O appearing in each category are fixed. You can choose as many Quà Tặng E.G.O as it is available to you from the same category.
You can obtain extra Ánh Sao by choosing an Quà Tặng E.G.O category that you did not use in your immediately preceding run.
Forming the Team
Select Sinners who will participate in the Hầm Ngục Gương run.
In the Hầm Ngục Gương deployment stage, all Identity Levels will be fixed to 45. In the Ritornello difficulty, your current Identity levels will be reflected instead. (Max Lv. 45)
Deploy 1★ or 2★ Identities to gain additional Cost upon entry.
Deploy Identities that have not been used in your immediately preceding Run to gain additional Cost upon entry.
Rest Bonus
The deployed Identity's Rest Bonus will be completely exhausted upon clearing the Hầm Ngục Gương. The more Rest Bonus you exhaust, the more Ánh Sao you will earn.
However, Identities that have been swapped in or out during the Hầm Ngục Gương run will not spend their Rest Bonuses, and will not provide additional Ánh Sao.
Identities that did not spend their Rest Bonuses, and Identities that were not swapped in or out will gain 1 Bar of Rest Bonus.
Entering the Hầm Ngục Gương
After finishing up the initial Team setup, press 'Confirm' to enter the Hầm Ngục Gương.
This area displays the additional Cost you have gained over the deployment process.
Selecting Floor Gói Chủ Đề

Upon entering a new Floor, you will be presented with a collection of different 'Themes' that you can choose to face on this Floor. Select and pull down a Theme Pack you would like to challenge for this Floor.
You can view the available Bosses and Quà Tặng E.G.O from the Theme Pack by pressing this button in the top right corner of each Theme Pack.
At the bottom of the Floor Gói Chủ Đề, you can view the Quà Tặng E.G.O that you can choose from after defeating the boss of the Floor Theme.

Because each Floor Theme has a set range of Quà Tặng E.G.O and Choices, it would be most effective to choose the Floor Theme Pack that has enemies that are weak to your current Team composition, or Floor Gói Chủ Đề with Quà Tặng E.G.O that you need.
Exploring Hầm Ngục Gươngs
The Hầm Ngục Gương rooms and paths are randomly generated.
You proceed by moving to nodes adjacent to your current node. You may find various events or combat encounters in each of the nodes.
Ánh Sao & Starting Cost

You will earn 'Ánh Sao' and 'Cost' as you proceed through the Hầm Ngục Gương. Ánh Sao can be spent to engrave stars(activate) Starter Buffs, and 'Cost' can be spent at Shops and Rest Stops found in the Hầm Ngục Gương.
Quà Tặng E.G.O
Acquired Quà Tặng E.G.O are displayed here. Quà Tặng E.G.O are items that offer powerful effects that last until the end of the Dungeon.
Effective Attacks
Below the combat Encounter nodes in Hầm Ngục Gươngs are types and affinities effective against the enemies in each node.
Sinner Status
The HP, SP, and lost lives of your Sinners will carry over between encounters.
Shops
At Shops, you can spend your 'Cost' to purchase Quà Tặng E.G.O, hồi allies, deploy/swap out additional Identities or power up selected Identities.
At Shops, you can sell Quà Tặng E.G.O you don't use to obtain 'Cost'.
Rest Stops
At Rest Stops, you can spend your 'Cost' to hồi allies, deploy/swap out additional Identities or enhance Quà Tặng E.G.O.
You can Fuse Quà Tặng E.G.O to obtain different Quà Tặng E.G.O.
Encounter Reward Cards
There is a chance for 'Encounter Reward Cards' to appear after winning an Encounter. The harder the Encounter difficulty, the higher the chance of obtaining an Encounter Reward Card.
You can obtain various resources such as Cost, Ánh Sao, Quà Tặng E.G.O, or E.G.O Resources from the Encounter Reward Cards.
Floor Buffs
Upon clearing a floor, you will obtain random enemy buffs tied to each Quà Tặng E.G.O.
Enemy Buffs will continue to stack with every floor cleared.
Hầm Ngục Gương Rewards
Upon clearing a Hầm Ngục Gương run, spend Enkephalin Modules to claim your rewards.
The amount of rewards depends on the number of cleared Floors. You can use Weekly Bonus chances to claim even more rewards.
Mirror of the Dreaming
Season 5's Hầm Ngục Gương is called 'Mirror of the Dreaming'.
Select the door or the "Enter" button to begin your Hầm Ngục Gương run.
Weekly Bonuses

Every week, you're given 3 Weekly Bonus eligibilities
to gain additional Hầm Ngục Gương rewards.

Using a Weekly Bonus eligibility when claiming your reward,
and receive greatly increased rewards.
If you chose Hard difficulty Gói Chủ Đề for every Floor, you can consume 2 or more Weekly Bonuses at once, and will receive rewards proportional to the number of Weekly Bonuses used.
However, it is more enkephalin-efficient to use 1 Weekly Bonus at a time rather than to use them all at once.
Sinners
You can view your currently deployed Sinners here.
Theme Pack Compendium
You can view the list of Gói Chủ Đề that appear in the Hầm Ngục Gương. Selected Theme Pack records will be collected here.
Quà Tặng E.G.O Compendium
You can view the list of Quà Tặng E.G.O that appear in the Hầm Ngục Gương. Obtaining an Quà Tặng E.G.O in the Hầm Ngục Gương will add an entry to your Quà Tặng E.G.O Compendium.
Creating your TEAM
Select Identities to run this Dungeon with.
In Hầm Ngục Gương Normal, all Identity Levels will be fixed to 50. In Hầm Ngục Gương Hard, your current Identity levels will be reflected instead. (max Lv. 50)
Rest Bonus
Upon entering Hầm Ngục Gương, you can spend the Rest Bonus of the Identities in your Team to select special effects from Grace of the Dreaming Star.
Upon clearing Hầm Ngục Gương, Rest Bonus for Identities in your current Hầm Ngục Gương Team resets to 0, and every other Identity gains 1 Rest Bonus.
Identities that have been swapped in or out during the Hầm Ngục Gương run will, however, neither spend nor gain Rest Bonuses.
Once you're finished with the Team ID & E.G.O setup, press 'Confirm' to enter the Hầm Ngục Gương.
You can view your team's sum of Rest Bonuses here.
Grace of the Dreaming Star
Spend your Team's Rest Bonuses to select Graces of Stars.
Remaining Rest Bonus
Remaining Rest Bonus after selecting Graces of Stars will be converted to 'Cost' to be used during your Hầm Ngục Gương run.
Grace of Stars Passives do not consume your Rest Bonuses; they activate automatically if you have enough Rest Bonuses.
Remaining Rest Bonus will be converted to 'Cost' to be used during your Hầm Ngục Gương run.
Starting Quà Tặng E.G.O Choice
Upon Hầm Ngục Gương entry, you will be given Keyword categories to choose Quà Tặng E.G.O from.
Quà Tặng E.G.O appearing in each category are fixed. You can choose as many Quà Tặng E.G.O as it is available to you from the same category.
Through your Hầm Ngục Gương run, Quà Tặng E.G.O in the category you selected here will appear more frequently.
Selecting Gói Chủ Đề

Upon entering a new Floor, you will be presented with a collection of different 'Themes' that you can choose to face on this Floor. Select and pull down a Theme Pack you would like to challenge for this Floor.
You can view the available Bosses and Quà Tặng E.G.O(obtainable as Encounter rewards) from the Theme Pack by pressing this button in the top right corner of each Theme Pack.
At the bottom of the Gói Chủ Đề, you can view the list of Quà Tặng E.G.O that you can choose from after defeating the boss of this Theme Pack.
Choosing the Theme Pack Difficulty
In Mirror of the Dreaming, you can select the difficulty of the upcoming floor in the Theme Pack selection phase.
However, once you enter the Hard difficulty, it cannot be changed again.
Hard Difficulty
In Hard Gói Chủ Đề, you will be able to choose 4 instead of 3 Quà Tặng E.G.O upon clearing the Floor Boss. Also, some Quà Tặng E.G.O are exclusive to Hard difficulty.
Also, you must select 2 Quà Tặng E.G.O and 2 Mounting Trials in Hard difficulty, and there's a chance for a Super Shop to spawn.
Exploring Hầm Ngục Gươngs
The Hầm Ngục Gương Encounters and paths are randomly generated.
You proceed by moving to nodes adjacent to your current node. You may find various events or combat encounters in each of the nodes.
Cost
You will earn 'Cost' as you proceed through the Hầm Ngục Gương. 'Cost' you earned can be spent at Shops for their various services.
Quà Tặng E.G.O
Acquired Quà Tặng E.G.O are displayed here. Quà Tặng E.G.O are items that offer powerful effects that last until the end of the Dungeon.
Effective Attacks & Cost Rewards
Combat Encounter nodes of Hầm Ngục Gươngs display affinity/attack type useful for that battle. It also displays the amount of Cost reward you can gain by completing it.
Sinner Status
The HP, SP, and lives of Sinners lost will carry over between encounters.
Active Effects
View your Mounting Trials, Rest Bonus, and Choice Event Effects here.
Shops
Nodes before Theme Pack Boss Encounters are shops.
At Shops, you can spend your 'Cost' to purchase Quà Tặng E.G.O, hồi or revive allies, deploy/swap out additional Identities, or replace Identity Skills.
Also, you can sell your Quà Tặng E.G.O at Shops to gain more Cost or Fuse your Quà Tặng E.G.O to gain even more useful Quà Tặng E.G.O.
In Hard difficulty, there is a chance for a Super Shop to appear. The more Cost you spend in a Hầm Ngục Gương run, the greater the chance becomes for it to appear.
Encounter Reward Cards
There is a chance for 'Encounter Reward Cards' to appear after winning an Encounter. The harder the Encounter difficulty, the higher the chance of obtaining an Encounter Reward Card.
You can obtain various resources such as Cost, Quà Tặng E.G.O, or E.G.O Resources from the Encounter Reward Cards.
Quà Tặng E.G.O & Mounting Trials
Upon clearing a floor, you will obtain random enemy buffs linked to each Quà Tặng E.G.O.
Mounting Trials will continue to stack with every floor cleared.
In Hard difficulty, you can select 2 Quà Tặng E.G.O. However, this means that you will be selecting 2 Mounting Trials in the process as well.
Hầm Ngục Gương Rewards
Upon clearing a Hầm Ngục Gương run, spend Enkephalin Modules to claim your rewards.
The amount of rewards depends on the number of cleared Floors. You can use Weekly Bonus chances to claim even more rewards.
If you chose Hard difficulty Gói Chủ Đề for every Floor, you can consume 2 or more Weekly Bonuses at once, and will receive rewards proportional to the number of Weekly Bonuses used.
However, it is more enkephalin-efficient to use 1 Weekly Bonus at a time rather than to use them all at once.
Achievements
You can view the Achievements for The Mirror of the Dreaming here.
Achievements List
Complete these Achievements to raise your Achievements progress.

Achievements that require the player to 'clear' the Hầm Ngục Gương count only when the Enkephalin Modules have been consumed at the reward claim window.

Please note this information before attempting to complete an Achievement tied to clearing the Hầm Ngục Gương.
Rewards List
Receive various rewards by raising your Achievements progress bar.
Parallel Superposition Mode
Engage the Parallel Superposition Mode to extend the Hầm Ngục Gương up to 10 Floors.
Please note that Parallel Superposition Mode is solely for Achievements, and does not yield additional rewards on its own past Floor 5.
You can choose at any time to engage the Parallel Superposition Mode at the Hầm Ngục Gương entrance and the Dungeon Progress window.
However, in order to enter the Parallel Superposition Mode, you had to have finished every Floor Theme Pack up to Floor 5 of that run in Hard difficulty.
Clear Floor 5 while the Parallel Superposition Mode is engaged, and a prompt will appear asking if you would like to enter the Parallel Superposition Mode.
Confirm to enter Parallel Superposition Mode and move up to Floor 6.
Please note that failing or exiting the Hầm Ngục Gương at any point past Floor 5 will still yield full Floor 5 Clear Rewards.
Added with the Feb 27th, 2025 (KST) Scheduled Update
Mirror of Immortality
Season 6's Hầm Ngục Gương is called 'Mirror of Immortality'.
Select the door or the "Enter" button to begin your Hầm Ngục Gương run.
Weekly Bonuses

Every week, you're given 3 Weekly Bonus eligibilities
to gain additional Hầm Ngục Gương rewards.

Using a Weekly Bonus eligibility when claiming your reward,
and receive greatly increased rewards.

If you chose Hard Difficulty Gói Chủ Đề for every Floor before clearing the Hầm Ngục Gương run, you can consume 2 or more Weekly Bonuses at once, and will receive rewards proportional to the number of Weekly Bonuses used.
However, it is more enkephalin-efficient to use 1 Weekly Bonus at a time rather than to use them all at once.
Ánh Sao
Mirror of Immortality adds various options and avenues to spend Ánh Sao to help you through the dungeon, including but not limited to Grace of Stars, Observations, and Wishmaking.

The amount of Ánh Sao gained is proportional to the number of Floors reached and the number of Hard difficulty Packs cleared. You can also gain additional Ánh Sao by clearing Refraction Railway Gói Chủ Đề or selecting Ánh Sao Encounter Reward Cards.

You can also gain a large amount of Ánh Sao by Extracting a newly released 3★ Identity or E.G.O within a certain timeframe.
※ Please note that you cannot gain Ánh Sao by obtaining them via the Dispenser.
Ánh Sao obtained from Extraction are immediately made usable for in-progress Hầm Ngục Gươngs as well.
Sinners
You can view your currently deployed Sinners here.
Theme Pack Compendium

You can view the list of Gói Chủ Đề that appear in the Hầm Ngục Gương.
Selected Theme Pack records will be collected here.
Quà Tặng E.G.O Compendium

You can view the list of Quà Tặng E.G.O that appear in the Hầm Ngục Gương.
Obtaining an Quà Tặng E.G.O in the Hầm Ngục Gương will add an entry to your Quà Tặng E.G.O Compendium.
Team Loadout
Select Identities to participate in battle.
In Hầm Ngục Gương Easy, all Identity Levels will be fixed to 55. In Hầm Ngục Gương Hard, your current Identity Levels will be reflected instead, up to Level 55.
Please note that, however, Identity Uptie Tiers and E.G.O Threadspinning Tiers will not be affected.
Ánh Sao Bonus
In the Hầm Ngục Gương Sinner Team loadout menu, you can view each Identity's Ánh Sao Bonus bars.
The sum of obtainable Ánh Sao from each Identity's Ánh Sao Bonuses in your current Team can be viewed here, at the bottom right corner, above the Confirmation button.
Ánh Sao, which are obtained via Ánh Sao Bonuses, are used to activate Grace of Stars.
Upon clearing Hầm Ngục Gương, Ánh Sao Bonuses for Identities in your current Hầm Ngục Gương Team resets to 0, and every other Identity gains 1 Ánh Sao Bonus.
Identities that have been swapped in or out during the Hầm Ngục Gương run will, however, neither spend nor gain Ánh Sao Bonuses.
Grace of the Immortal Star
Spend Ánh Sao Bonuses obtained from your Team loadout to select Grace of Stars.
If you have more Ánh Sao in additional to Ánh Sao Bonuses, you can spend them as well to select more Grace of Stars or enhance your selected Grace of Stars.
Remaining Ánh Sao Bonus after selecting Graces of Stars will be converted to 'Cost' to be used during your Hầm Ngục Gương run.
※ Owned Ánh Sao are not converted into Costs.
Starting Quà Tặng E.G.O Choice
Upon Hầm Ngục Gương entry, you will be given Keyword categories to choose Quà Tặng E.G.O from.
Quà Tặng E.G.O appearing in each category are fixed. You can choose as many Quà Tặng E.G.O as it is available to you from the same category.
Through your Hầm Ngục Gương run, Quà Tặng E.G.O in the category you selected here will appear more frequently.
Selecting Gói Chủ Đề

Upon entering a new Floor, you will be presented with a collection of different 'Themes' that you can choose to face on this Floor. Select and pull down a Theme Pack you would like to challenge for this Floor.
You can view the available Bosses and Quà Tặng E.G.O(obtainable as Encounter rewards) from the Theme Pack by pressing this button in the top right corner of each Theme Pack.
At the bottom of the Gói Chủ Đề, you can view the list of Quà Tặng E.G.O that you can choose from after defeating the boss of this Theme Pack.
Choosing the Theme Pack Difficulty
In Mirror of Immortality, you can select the difficulty of the upcoming floor in the Theme Pack selection phase.
However, once you enter the Hard difficulty, it cannot be changed again.
Hard Difficulty

In Hard Gói Chủ Đề, you will be able to choose 4 instead of 3 Quà Tặng E.G.O upon clearing the Floor Boss. Also, while you can pick two Quà Tặng E.G.O from the said pool, you will also be selecting two Mounting Trials.

In Hard Difficulty, you might come across certain special Shops.
Also, certain Quà Tặng E.G.O are exclusive to the Hard Difficulty.
Theme Pack Observation(Search)
By using the new addition Theme Pack Observation, or "Pack Search", you can choose specific Gói Chủ Đề from the list of available Packs in the current Floor and Difficulty combination.
Selecting the "Pack Search" button will change the top right corner buttons of each Gói Chủ Đề to Refresh icons. Select those icons to enter the Theme Pack Observation window.
Spend Ánh Sao to select an available Theme Pack in the current Floor & Difficulty combination. Previously unobserved Gói Chủ Đề spend more Ánh Sao to select.
However, please be warned that the more you use the Theme Pack Observation function, the more Ánh Sao it will cost to use.
Exploring Hầm Ngục Gươngs
The Hầm Ngục Gương Encounters and paths are randomly generated.
You proceed by moving to nodes adjacent to your current node. You may find various events or combat encounters in each of the nodes.

The HP, SP, and lost lives of your Sinners will carry over between encounters.

In Hard difficulty, there is a chance for a Super Shop to appear. The more Cost you spend in a Hầm Ngục Gương run, the greater the chance becomes for it to appear.
Fusion - Wishmaking
Wishmaking is a new option; spend additional Ánh Sao to improve the Quà Tặng E.G.O Fusion success rate.
The cost of Wishmaking remains the same no matter how many times it is used.
Encounter Reward Cards
There is a chance for 'Encounter Reward Cards' to appear after winning an Encounter. The harder the Encounter difficulty, the higher the chance of obtaining an Encounter Reward Card.
You can obtain various resources such as Cost, Ánh Sao, Quà Tặng E.G.O, or E.G.O Resources from the Encounter Reward Cards.
Quà Tặng E.G.O & Mounting Trials
Upon clearing a floor, you will obtain random enemy buffs linked to each Quà Tặng E.G.O.
Mounting Trials will continue to stack with every floor cleared.
In Hard difficulty, you can select 2 Quà Tặng E.G.O. However, this means that you will be selecting 2 Mounting Trials in the process as well.
Hầm Ngục Gương Rewards

Mirror Projection / Achievements

Clearing a Hầm Ngục Gương run or completing an Achievement raises your Projection rate.

You can obtain various rewards by meeting Projection milestones.
Achievements
Raise your Projection rate by completing various Achievements.

※ Achievements that require the player to 'clear' the Hầm Ngục Gương count only when the Enkephalin Modules have been consumed at the reward claim window. Please note this information before attempting to complete them.
Projection Rewards
You can obtain various rewards by meeting Projection rate milestones.
Quà Tặng E.G.O Search
Use Quà Tặng E.G.O Search to select and obtain an Quà Tặng E.G.O from the list.
You can toggle ON/OFF the Quà Tặng E.G.O Search function
You cannot select an Quà Tặng E.G.O you already own, and the cost of selecting Quà Tặng E.G.O grows more expensive the more Quà Tặng E.G.O you select.
Identity Rental
Through the Identity Rental system, you can experience the Hầm Ngục Gương with new Identities in a preset Team.
Select the rental button to enter the Identity Rental menu.
Rental Team
Each Rental Team can be rented to play through the Hầm Ngục Gương once over their respective rental periods.
Claiming the Hầm Ngục Gương Clear Reward will consume your Rental chance.
You cannot enter the Parallel Superposition mode with a Rental Team.
Rental Teams use preset Identities and E.G.O, none of which can be changed.
All Identities in the Rental Team receive maximum Ánh Sao Bonuses.
Rental Teams' loadouts cannot be edited or altered.
Rental Team Rewards
You can gain Ánh Sao and Event currencies by using Rental Teams.
Only one out of three Weekly Bonuses can be consumed when clearing a Hầm Ngục Gương with a Rental Team.
Parallel Superposition Mode
Engage the Parallel Superposition Mode to extend the Hầm Ngục Gương up to 10 Floors.
Please note that Parallel Superposition Mode is solely for Achievements, and does not yield additional rewards on its own past Floor 5.
You can choose at any time to engage the Parallel Superposition Mode at the Hầm Ngục Gương entrance and the Dungeon Progress window.
However, in order to enter the Parallel Superposition Mode, you had to have finished every Floor Theme Pack up to Floor 5 of that run in Hard difficulty.
Clear Floor 5 while the Parallel Superposition Mode is engaged, and a prompt will appear asking if you would like to enter the Parallel Superposition Mode.
Confirm to enter Parallel Superposition Mode and move up to Floor 6.
Please note that failing or exiting the Hầm Ngục Gương at any point past Floor 5 will still yield full Floor 5 Clear Rewards.
Hạn Mức Phản Chiếu Hằng Tuần
You can earn "Projection" rate by clearing the Hầm Ngục Gương and claiming its rewards. Obtainable Projection rate changes based on your progress and choices made during your Hầm Ngục Gương runs.
Increasing your Projection rate raises your Mirror Projection Level. Various rewards await at each level milestone.
There is a weekly cap to how much Projection rate can be earned. The weekly cap resets every Thursday 6AM (KST).
Parallel Superposition EXTREME
Clear Floor 10 while the Parallel Superposition Mode is engaged, and a prompt will appear asking if you would like to enter the Parallel Superposition EXTREME Mode.
Confirm to enter Parallel Superposition EXTREME Mode and move up to Floor 11.
Please note that failing or exiting the Hầm Ngục Gương at any point will still yield Clear Rewards based on the Floor you cleared last.
Set Adversities
Starting from Floor 11, you can select "Adversities".
You can select up to 5 Adversities per Floor; your Adversity Score & Adversity effects stack with every Floor clear.

Select Adversities to gain bonus Ánh Sao and Projection rate based on your Adversity Score. However, please note that Adversity bonus rewards for each floor can be obtained only by clearing the Floor on which the Adversities were selected. Also, any other reward will be based on Floor 5 Clear rewards.
Selecting more Adversities will increase the difficulty. However, it will reward more Ánh Sao and Projection rate.
Tấm Gương Của Nhện Và Danh Xưng
Hầm Ngục Gương của Mùa 7 được gọi là 'Tấm Gương Của Nhện Và Danh Xưng'.
Nhấn vào cửa hoặc nút "Tiến Vào" để bắt đầu lần đi Hầm Ngục Gương.
Thưởng Hằng Tuần
Hằng tuần, ngài sẽ được nhận 3 lượt nhận Thưởng Hằng Tuần để nhận thêm phần thưởng từ Hầm Ngục Gương.
Sử dụng lượt nhận Thưởng Hằng Tuần khi nhận phần thưởng vào cuối lần đi, sẽ tăng đáng kể phần thưởng nhận được.
Nếu ngài chọn Gói Chủ Đề Chế Độ Khó cho toàn bộ Tầng trước khi hoàn thành lần đi Hầm Ngục Gương, ngài có thể dùng 2 hoặc nhiều lượt nhận, để nhận phần thưởng tương ứng với số lượt nhận đã sử dụng.
Tuy nhiêu, sử dụng 1 lượt nhận Thưởng sẽ tiết kiệm enkephalin hơn là sử dụng hết toàn bộ lượt nhận cùng một lúc.
Ánh Sao
Tấm Gương Của Nhện Và Danh Xưng có nhiều lựa chọn và lối chơi để ngài có thể sử dụng Ánh Sao và hỗ trợ cho lần đi hầm ngục, ví dụ như các đặc ân: Đặc Ân của Vì Sao, Tìm Gói, và Ước Nguyện.

Số Ánh Sao nhận được dựa theo số Tầng đã đi qua và số Gói chế độ Khó đã hoàn thành. Ngài cũng có thể nhận thêm Ánh Sao bằng cách hoàn thành các Gói Chủ Đề Đoàn Tàu Khúc Xạ hoặc chọn các thẻ Phần Quà Gặp Gỡ Ánh Sao.

Ngài cũng có thể nhận một lượng lớn Ánh Sao bằng cách Trích Xuất Danh Tính 3★ hoặc E.G.O mới ra mắt trong khoảng thời gian nhất định.
※ Xin lưu ý, ngài không thể nhận Ánh Sao bằng cách Quy Đổi các Danh Tính/E.G.O đó.
Ánh Sao nhận được từ Trích Xuất có thể được dùng ngay trong lần đi Hầm Ngục Gương còn dở.
Tội Nhân
Ngài có thể theo dõi các Tội Nhận hiện đang được triển khai ngay tại đây.
Tổng Hợp Gói Chủ Đề

Ngài có thể theo dõi danh sách Gói Chủ Đề có thể xuất hiện trong Hầm Ngục Gương.
Gói Chủ Đề đã chọn sẽ được lưu vào đây.
Quà Tặng E.G.O Compendium

Ngài có thể theo dõi danh sách Quà Tặng E.G.O có thể xuất hiện trong Hầm Ngục Gương.
Khi ngài nhận được Quà Tặng E.G.O trong Hầm Ngục Gương, nó sẽ được lưu lại trong Tổng Hợp Quà Tặng E.G.O.
Đội Hình
Chọn Danh Tính dể tham chiến.
Trong Hầm Ngục Gương Thường, Cấp của tất cả Danh Tính sẽ được cố định lên 60. Trong Hầm Ngục Gương Khó, Cấp Danh Tính của ngài dùng sẽ không được hưởng đặc quyền trên.
Xin lưu ý, Cấp Đòng Bộ Danh Tính và Cấp Thêu Dệt của E.G.O sẽ không bị ảnh hưởng.
Thưởng Ánh Sao
Trong màn hình Đội Hình Hầm Ngục Gương, ngài có thể theo dõi thanh Thưởng Ánh Sao của từng Danh Tính.
Tổng Ánh Sao có thể nhận được từ Thưởng Ánh Sao của từng Danh Tính sẽ được hiện tại đây, ở góc dưới bên phải, trên nút Xác Nhận.
Ánh Sao mà ngài nhận từ Thưởng Ánh Sao, được dùng dể kích hoạt các Đặc Ân của Vì Sao.
Sau khi hoàn thành Hầm Ngục Gương, Thanh Thưởng Ánh Sao của Danh Tính trong Đội Hình Hầm Ngục Gương mà ngài dùng sẽ về 0, và mọi Danh Tính còn lại sẽ được nhận 1 Thưởng Ánh Sao.
Tuy nhiên, các Danh tính được thay đổi ra và vào trong lần đi Hầm Ngục Gương sẽ không bị mất hoặc được thêm Thưởng Ánh Sao.
Đặc Ân của Vì Sao, Nhện và Danh Xưng
Sử dụng Thưởng Ánh Sao có được từ Đội Hình để chọn Đặc Ân của Vì Sao.
Nếu ngài có nhiều Ánh Sao, ngài có thể dùng chúng, cùng với số Thưởng Ánh Sao để chọn thêm các Đặc Ân của Vì Sao.
Nhấn nút này để chọn nhiều Đặc Ân cùng một lúc.
Sau khi chọn các Đặc Ân, số Thưởng Ánh Sao sót lại sẽ quy đổi thành 'Cost' mà ngài có thể sử dụng trong lần đi Hầm Ngục Gương.
※ Ánh Sao đang sở hữu sẽ không thể quy đổi thành Cost.
Lựa Chọn Quà Tặng E.G.O Khởi Đầu
Khi đi vào Hầm Ngục Gương, ngài sẽ được xem danh sách Từ Khóa để chọn Quà Tặng E.G.O.
Quà Tặng E.G.O được hiển thị trong danh sách này được cố định. Ngài có thể tùy ý số Quà Tặng E.G.O đang có trong cùng danh sách.
Quà Tặng E.G.O từ danh sách ngài chọn sẽ xuất hiện nhiều hơn xuyên suốt lần đi Hầm Ngục Gương.
Tìm Kiếm Quà Tặng E.G.O
Nhấn vào Tìm Kiếm Quà Tặng E.G.O để chọn và nhận Quà Tặng E.G.O trong danh sách.
Ngài có thể TẮT/MỞ chức năng Tìm Kiếm Quà Tặng E.G.O
Ngài không thể nhận thêm Quà Tặng E.G.O mà mình đã chọn, đồng thời, ngài càng chọn nhiều Quà Tặng E.G.O, giá để chọn Quà Tặng E.G.O sẽ ngày càng tăng.
Lựa Chọn Gói Chủ Đề
Khi bước vào Tầng mới, ngài sẽ được xem danh sách các 'Chủ Đề' mà ngài có thể lựa chọn đối đầu. Nhấn chọn Gói Chủ Đề và kéo xuống nếu ngài muốn thử thách trong Tầng này.
Ngài có thể xem Thủ Lĩnh và Quà Tặng E.G.O(nhận được từ thưởng Ải) có trong Gói Chủ Đề bằng cách nhấn nút ở góc trên bên phải của mỗi Gói.
Ở dưới mỗi Gói Chủ Đề, ngài có thể xem danh sách Quà Tặng E.G.O mà mình có thể chọn sau khi hạ gục thủ lĩnh của Gói Chủ Đề trên.
Chọn Chế Độ Gói Chủ Đề
Trong Tấm Gương Của Nhện Và Danh Xưng, ngài có thể chọn chế độ của các tầng khi đang ở màn hình lựa chọn Gói Chủ Đề.
Tuy nhiên, một khi ngài đã chọn chế độ Khó, ngài không thể điều chỉnh lại.
Chế Độ Khó

Trong các Gói Chủ Đề Khó, you will be able to choose 4 instead of 3 Quà Tặng E.G.O upon clearing the Floor Boss. Also, while you can pick two Quà Tặng E.G.O from the said pool, you will also be selecting two Mounting Trials.

In Hard Difficulty, you might come across certain special Shops.
Also, certain Quà Tặng E.G.O are exclusive to the Hard Difficulty.
Tìm Gói
By using the new addition Theme Pack Observation, or "Pack Search", you can choose specific Gói Chủ Đề from the list of available Packs in the current Floor and Difficulty combination.
Selecting the "Pack Search" button will change the top right corner buttons of each Gói Chủ Đề to Refresh icons. Select those icons to enter the Theme Pack Observation window.
Spend Ánh Sao to select an available Theme Pack in the current Floor & Difficulty combination. Previously unobserved Gói Chủ Đề spend more Ánh Sao to select.
However, please be warned that the more you use the Theme Pack Search function, the more Ánh Sao it will cost to use.
Khám phá Hầm Ngục Gươngs
Trong Hầm Ngục Gương, đường đi và Ải sẽ được đặt ngẫu nhiên.
You proceed by moving to nodes adjacent to your current node. You may find various events or combat encounters in each of the nodes.
Cost
You will earn 'Cost' as you proceed through the Hầm Ngục Gương. 'Cost' you earned can be spent at Shops for their various services.
Effective Attacks & Cost Rewards
Combat Encounter nodes of Hầm Ngục Gươngs display affinity/attack type useful for that battle. It also displays the amount of Cost reward you can gain by completing it.
Sinner Status
The HP, SP, and lost lives of your Sinners will carry over between encounters.
Quà Tặng E.G.O
Acquired Quà Tặng E.G.O are displayed here. Quà Tặng E.G.O are items that offer powerful effects that last until the end of the Dungeon.
Observe Team Loadout
You can view detailed information of the Identities in your loadout.
Active Effects
View your Mounting Trials, Grace of Stars, and Choice Event Effects here.
Shops
Nodes before Theme Pack Boss Encounters are shops.
At Shops, you can spend your 'Cost' to purchase Quà Tặng E.G.O, hồi or revive Sinners, deploy/swap out additional Identities, or replace Identity Skills.
Also, you can sell your Quà Tặng E.G.O at Shops to gain more Cost or Fuse your Quà Tặng E.G.O to gain even more useful Quà Tặng E.G.O.
In Hard difficulty, there is a chance for a Super Shop to appear. The more Cost you spend in a Hầm Ngục Gương run, the greater the chance becomes for it to appear.
Fusion Recipes
Some Quà Tặng E.G.O require specific recipes to fuse. View them here.
There are also Quà Tặng E.G.O whose recipes require certain Theme Pack exclusive Quà Tặng E.G.O as ingredients.
Fusion - Wishmaking
By using the Wishmaking function, you can spend additional Ánh Sao to improve the Quà Tặng E.G.O Fusion success rate.
The cost of Wishmaking remains the same no matter how many times it is used.
Encounter Reward Cards
There is a chance for 'Encounter Reward Cards' to appear after winning an Encounter. The harder the Encounter difficulty, the higher the chance of obtaining an Encounter Reward Card.
You can obtain various resources such as Cost, Ánh Sao, Quà Tặng E.G.O, or E.G.O Resources from the Encounter Reward Cards.
Quà Tặng E.G.O & Mounting Trials
Upon clearing a floor, you will obtain random enemy buffs linked to each Quà Tặng E.G.O.
Mounting Trials will continue to stack with every floor cleared.
In Hard difficulty, you can select 2 Quà Tặng E.G.O. However, this means that you will be selecting 2 Mounting Trials in the process as well.
Hầm Ngục Gương Rewards
Upon clearing a Hầm Ngục Gương run, spend Enkephalin Modules to claim your rewards.
The amount of rewards depends on the number of cleared Floors. You can use Weekly Bonus chances to claim even more rewards.
If you chose Hard difficulty Gói Chủ Đề for every Floor, you can consume 2 or more Weekly Bonuses at once, and will receive rewards proportional to the number of Weekly Bonuses used.
However, it is more enkephalin-efficient to use 1 Weekly Bonus at a time rather than to use them all at once.
Achievements
Achievements is a game content in which you beat challenges to gain Projection rate to earn various rewards.
Team Rental
Through the Team Rental system, you can experience the Hầm Ngục Gương with new Identities in a preset Team.
Select the rental button to enter the Team Rental menu.
Team Rental
Each Rental Team can be rented to play through the Hầm Ngục Gương once over their respective rental periods.
Claiming the Hầm Ngục Gương Clear Reward will consume your Rental chance.
You cannot enter the Parallel Superposition mode with a Rental Team.
Rental Teams use preset Identities and E.G.O, none of which can be changed.
All Identities in the Rental Team receive maximum Ánh Sao Bonuses.
You cannot change your loadout once you have entered with a Rental Team.
Team Rental Rewards
You can gain Ánh Sao and Event currencies by using Rental Teams.
Only one Weekly Bonus can be consumed when clearing a Hầm Ngục Gương with a Rental Team.
Parallel Superposition Mode
Engage the Parallel Superposition Mode to extend the Hầm Ngục Gương up to 10 Floors.
Please note that Parallel Superposition Mode is solely for challenges and upcoming Achievements, and does not yield additional rewards on its own past Floor 5.
You can choose at any time to engage the Parallel Superposition Mode at the Hầm Ngục Gương entrance and the Dungeon Progress window.
However, in order to enter the Parallel Superposition Mode, you had to have finished every Floor Theme Pack up to Floor 5 of that run in Hard difficulty.
Clear Floor 5 while the Parallel Superposition Mode is engaged, and a prompt will appear asking if you would like to enter the Parallel Superposition Mode.
Confirm to enter Parallel Superposition Mode and move up to Floor 6.
Please note that failing or exiting the Hầm Ngục Gương at any point past Floor 5 will still yield full Floor 5 Clear Rewards.
Mirror Projection / Achievements
Completing an Achievement or clearing a Hầm Ngục Gương raises your Projection Rate.
You can obtain various rewards by meeting Projection rate milestones.
Achievements
Raise your Projection rate by completing various Achievements.

※ Achievements that require the player to 'clear' the Hầm Ngục Gương count only when the Enkephalin Modules have been consumed at the reward claim window. Please note this information before attempting to complete them.
Projection Rewards
You can obtain various rewards by meeting Projection rate milestones.
Weekly Projection
You can earn "Projection" rate by clearing the Hầm Ngục Gương and claiming its rewards. Obtainable Projection rate changes based on your progress and choices made during your Hầm Ngục Gương runs.
Increasing your Projection rate raises your Tấm Gương Của Nhện Và Danh Xưng Pass Projection Level. Various rewards await at each level milestone.
There is a weekly cap to how much experience points can be earned. The weekly cap resets every Thursday 6AM (KST).
Parallel Superposition EXTREME
Clear Floor 10 while the Parallel Superposition Mode is engaged, and a prompt will appear asking if you would like to enter the Parallel Superposition EXTREME Mode.
Confirm to enter Parallel Superposition EXTREME Mode and move up to Floor 11.
Please note that failing or exiting the Hầm Ngục Gương at any point will still yield Clear Rewards based on the Floor you cleared last.
Set Adversities
Starting from Floor 11, you can select "Adversities".
You can select up to 5 Adversities per Floor; your Adversity Score & Adversity effects stack with every Floor clear.

Select Adversities to gain bonus Ánh Sao and Tấm Gương Của Nhện Và Danh Xưng Pass Projection rate based on your Adversity Score. However, please note that Adversity bonus rewards for each floor can be obtained only by clearing the Floor on which the Adversities were selected. Also, any other reward will be based on Floor 5 Clear rewards.
Selecting more Adversities will increase the difficulty. However, it will reward more Ánh Sao and Tấm Gương Của Nhện Và Danh Xưng Pass Projection rate.
Fusion - Autoselect
Once you have gathered all the Quà Tặng E.G.O necessary for a Fusion, you can automatically place them into the Fusion slot by clicking the fusible Quà Tặng E.G.O result.

※ Even if you have gathered all the required Gifts, regular shops will not allow Fusions if a Fusion requires more than 3 slots.
Try fusing lower-tier Gifts or use a Super Shop instead.
